scripts.title: Paint Over Paint
scripts.features:
Allows you to paint over other peoples paint (and your own paint)

Changelog:
07/01/2022: Fixed sponge error, should now work with sponges <3
scripts.script:
local OldNamecall; OldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, '__namecall', function(self, ...)
	local Args = {...}
	local Method = getnamecallmethod()
	local Script = getcallingscript()

	if not checkcaller() and self == workspace and Method == 'Raycast' and Script then
        if Script.Parent.Name == 'SprayPaint' then
            local Params = RaycastParams.new()
            Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace.Map, workspace.PaintFolder }
            Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Whitelist
            
            Args[3] = Params
        elseif Script.Parent.Name == 'Sponge' then
            local Params = RaycastParams.new()
            Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace.Map, workspace.PaintFolder }
            Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Whitelist
            
            Args[3] = Params
        end
	end

	return OldNamecall(self, table.unpack(Args))
end)

scripts.title: Rainbow spray effect
scripts.features: Rainbow spray effect, nothing special but its a cool thing i made, and i thought i would share it !
scripts.script:
if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:wait() end 
local IsDescendantOf = game.IsDescendantOf
local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:wait()

local OldNamecall

OldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall",function(...)
        local Args = {...}
        if getnamecallmethod() == "FireServer" then
            if tostring(Args[1]) == "SprayEffect" and IsDescendantOf(Args[1], Character) then
                for _ = 1, 25 do
                    Args[3] = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(1, 255), math.random(1, 255), math.random(1, 255))
                    OldNamecall(unpack(Args))
                end
            else
                return OldNamecall(unpack(Args))
            end
        end
        return OldNamecall(unpack(Args))
 end)
